name: Music-Bar "TIME"
kurzbeschreibung:
**Music-Bar "TIME" in Imst**

Discover the vibrant nightlife of **Imst** at the **Music-Bar "TIME"**, where the energy never stops! Whether you're into electronic beats, rock anthems, or just looking for a fun evening with friends, this lively spot has it all.

Sip on craft cocktails, enjoy live music, or dance the night away on the spacious dance floor. The cozy yet modern atmosphere makes it the perfect place to unwind after a day of exploring the stunning landscapes of **Tirol**.

Don’t miss out—**Music-Bar "TIME"** is your go-to destination for unforgettable nights in the heart of the Alps!
